title: Supplementary participles
subtitle: Read participles that complete a verb’s meaning.
overview: Some verbs of perception, beginning, continuing, or stopping take a participle that completes the verbal idea. Do not treat it as an optional side note.
Identify the governing verb and ask what action is being seen, heard, begun, continued, or stopped.

items.grc: εἶδεν δύο ἀδελφοὺς βάλλοντας ἀμφίβληστρον εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν.
items.en: He saw two brothers casting a net into the sea.

items.grc: καὶ ἤκουσαν αὐτοῦ διδάσκοντος ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ.
items.en: And they heard him teaching in the synagogue.
